title: DSP Utilities Module
summary: This module provides essential utility functions for DSPy, including text tokenization, answer location within text, robust configuration management, and batch loading of background data for retrieval tasks.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: Simple Text Tokenizer
nodes.description: A tokenizer that splits text into tokens based on alphanumeric characters and non-whitespace patterns, primarily used for text processing in retrieval tasks.

nodes.label: Locate Answers in Text
nodes.title: Answer Location Utility
nodes.description: Identifies and returns the character-based offset and end position of all occurrences of given tokenized answers within a larger body of text.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.description: A singleton class providing thread-safe management of global DSPy configuration settings, including language models, adapters, and callbacks, with support for thread-local overrides via context managers.

nodes.label: Load Batch Backgrounds
nodes.title: Batch Background Loader
nodes.description: Retrieves and concatenates background passages for a list of query IDs from a collection, supporting both integer and string-based passage identifiers.

groups.label: Text Processing
groups.title: Text Processing Utilities
groups.description: Components for tokenizing text and locating specific phrases within tokenized content.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: DSPy Configuration
groups.description: Manages global and thread-local settings for DSPy, ensuring consistent behavior across the application.

groups.label: Data Loading
groups.title: Background Data Loading
groups.description: Utility for loading and preparing background passages associated with query IDs.
